calendar.matters:
AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Feb-28-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Dept. 218, Judge: Ollie Marie Victoire, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Helen Sorep-Matley, 925.
Violet Grayson, Esq. appeared with petitioner Breanna Siobhan Kilgo-Kelly
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Brian Sean Kilgo-Kelly.

The Court further orders the gender of Breanna Siobhan Kilgo-Kelly is changed from Female to Male.

Decree Changing Name and Gender was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
